parameters.query: INSERT INTO mrr_snapshots (snapshot_date, mrr_eur, active_subscriptions, mrr_lite, mrr_pro, mrr_max, captured_at) VALUES ($1::date, $2::numeric, $3::int, $4::numeric, $5::numeric, $6::numeric, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (snapshot_date) DO UPDATE SET mrr_eur = EXCLUDED.mrr_eur, active_subscriptions = EXCLUDED.active_subscriptions, mrr_lite = EXCLUDED.mrr_lite, mrr_pro = EXCLUDED.mrr_pro, mrr_max = EXCLUDED.mrr_max, captured_at = NOW() RETURNING id;

meta.author: klantkraan
meta.notes: No outbound to customers — no suppression check needed. Mollie subscription listing assumes single page; for >250 subs add a pagination loop in the n8n UI.
